title: Reuse exact canonical CSR index tuples
masterplan_authority: Revision 11 / Version 2.2.0 / Gate 1 — Renovation and owner-directed Genesis
finding: TypedRelationBlock already treats row_offsets and column_indices as validated immutable canonical CSR index tuples. Construction nevertheless wrapped both bounded sequences in tuple(...) unconditionally, so an exact tuple supplied by canonical relation-block builders was copied into a second equal tuple before the existing CSR validation pass. Values are intentionally excluded from this optimization because _stored(...) remains the canonical semiring scalar validation/normalization boundary.
primary_claim: TypedRelationBlock now reuses exact tuple row_offsets and column_indices by object identity while retaining the existing bounded-sequence and CSR validation. Non-tuple sequence input is still normalized to tuple form. Values still pass through _stored(...) exactly as before. Fourfold subject identity, typed planes, relation signatures, semiring semantics, CSR ordering, lookup/composition behavior, wire serialization and digest semantics are unchanged.
gardener_decision: Reuse the already canonical immutable CSR index containers rather than add a cache, index wrapper, adapter, second tensor representation or other parallel abstraction. Keep conversion only for inputs that actually require tuple normalization. This removes redundant canonical-path allocation rather than optimizing for source-line count.
acceptance: exact canonical row_offsets and column_indices tuples are retained by object identity after TypedRelationBlock validation
